obligations.note: POST /payees/{id}/reopen is bound to the privileged action manage_payees with mfa=False, and tests.controls.test_routes_control#test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on that route. EXC-0210 expired on 2026-09-03, before review on 2026-10-12, and it is limited to the reconciliation batch account while the route skips MFA for every caller.
reopen_payee updates only status and closed_at and does not write NPI columns. The exhaustive control test test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed on the head commit.
reopen_payee calls _audit with the actor, action reopen_payee, payee target, and the service clock. The sampled audit control test passed, and the new operation records the required event.
The new statement is the fixed string UPDATE payees SET status = 'open', closed_at = NULL WHERE id = ? with payee_id bound as a parameter. The exhaustive SQL control test passed on the head commit.
Ticket CHG-25756 is approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-04, before review, and its components cover payments.http, payments.routes, payments.service, and payments.store.
Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver and not the author, approved a code_review of commit f280478c87183418aa331fa38c925a30c825f601.
The change is a single commit, and the code_review and security_review approvals both name that head commit.
records/ci/run.json reports failure on the head commit: 172 tests, 1 failure, including the unskipped MFA-1 control test. The full suite did not pass.
The diff touches security-sensitive components payments.http, payments.routes, and payments.store. Ines Halvorsen, a security_reviewer, approved a security_review of the head commit.
The diff does not include protected paths under controls, control tests, or ci, so a control-owner approval is not required.
The ticket type is standard and the change record sets emergency to false, so a post-implementation review is not due.

The MFA deviation relies on EXC-0210. That exception is expired at the 2026-10-12 review time, and its scope is the reconciliation batch account while the route omits MFA for every manage_payees caller.
Acceptance ledger ACR-0404 covers routes.py for MFA-1. This change alters that file's behavior, and the replacement exhaustive control test failed on the head commit.

summary: The change adds POST /payees/{id}/reopen for the privileged manage_payees action with MFA turned off. The cited exception EXC-0210 expired on 2026-09-03, before this review, and does not match a route that skips MFA for every caller. CI on the final commit fails the privileged-route MFA control test, so prior acceptance evidence for routes.py has lapsed and the change is not acceptable.
